records.claim: As of 24 August 2026, New Zealand's Skilled Migrant Category contains three distinct residence pathways: the Points-based pathway, Skilled Work Experience pathway, and Trades and Technician pathway. The generic NZ-skilled registry record therefore remains a research umbrella and must not be promoted as though one eligibility rule applies to all three.
records.methodology: Direct review of the current Immigration New Zealand Skilled Migrant Category Resident Visa page and the final August 2026 change notice; scope is recorded specifically to prevent umbrella-route overclaiming.

records.claim: The 24 August 2026 Skilled Migrant Category changes include clarified wage-threshold application, updated qualification evidence, removal of the overseas Trade and Technician 120-credit requirement, and strengthened genuine-skilled-employment settings. The Skilled Work Experience and Trades and Technician pathways have distinct work-experience and qualification rules, so route-specific evidence is required before promotion.
records.methodology: Direct review of Immigration New Zealand's final 18 June 2026 announcement for rules taking effect on 24 August 2026; recorded as current policy context, not as proof for an un-narrowed pathway.
